0x1026EE00.name: Mdl_ClearSlotFlags
0x1026EE00.evidence: for each of the DAT_1099AECC entries of 0xAC bytes at DAT_1099AED0, clears the dword at +0xA4 of the pointer stored at +0xA8 and clears bit 0x02 of the word at +0xA8
0x1026EE00.summary: Clears the flag fields of every slot in the table.

0x1026F1B0.name: Mdl_ReleaseEntries
0x1026F1B0.evidence: walks the DAT_1099AED8 entries of 0xC0 bytes at DAT_1099AEDC from the last one down, calls FUN_1027DB80 on each, then sets the count to 0
0x1026F1B0.summary: Releases every entry of the 0xC0-byte table and empties it.

0x1026F4F0.name: Mdl_GetEntryTable
0x1026F4F0.evidence: when the count DAT_1099AED8 is positive and the table DAT_1099AEDC is nonnull, stores the table pointer and the count through the two optional out-pointers and returns 1, else 0
0x1026F4F0.summary: Returns the entry table and its count when the table is populated.

0x1026F580.name: Mdl_QueryEntryFlag
0x1026F580.evidence: calls FUN_10285000 on the pointer at +0xB4 of entry param_1, stores 1 in the out-pointer and 0 when param_1 is zero
0x1026F580.summary: Stores whether the entry is valid, after a query on its pointer at +0xB4.

0x1026F7B0.name: Mdl_GetEntryWord0
0x1026F7B0.evidence: stores the dword at offset 0 of entry param_1 (entries are 0xC0 bytes) into the out-pointer
0x1026F7B0.summary: Returns the first dword of a table entry.

0x1026F9A0.name: Mdl_UpdateEntryFlags
0x1026F9A0.evidence: masks the argument with 0x32C and xors the entry's first dword when the mode is -1, ors it when the mode is nonzero, and clears it otherwise
0x1026F9A0.summary: Sets, clears or toggles the flag mask 0x32C in a table entry by mode.

0x1026FEA0.name: Mdl_FindNthFlag40
0x1026FEA0.evidence: walks the 0xAC-byte entries at DAT_1099AED0 and returns the index of the nth entry whose byte has bit 0x40 set, through the out-pointer
0x1026FEA0.summary: Finds the nth slot with flag 0x40 set and returns its index.

0x1026FF30.name: Mdl_FindNthNegative
0x1026FF30.evidence: walks the entries at DAT_1099AED0 and returns the index of the nth entry whose byte is negative (bit 0x80 set), through the out-pointer
0x1026FF30.summary: Finds the nth slot whose top flag bit is set and returns its index.

0x10270240.name: Mdl_GetSlotPtrs
0x10270240.evidence: stores the dword at +0xA8 of slot param_1 (0xAC-byte slots at DAT_1099AED0) in the first out-pointer and the address of the slot's +4 in the second
0x10270240.summary: Returns the value and address pointer of a slot.

0x10270290.name: Mdl_GetSlotWord0
0x10270290.evidence: stores the dword at offset 0 of slot param_1 (0xAC bytes each) into the out-pointer
0x10270290.summary: Returns the first dword of a slot.

0x102703C0.name: Mdl_UpdateSlotFlags
0x102703C0.evidence: applies a mask to the dword at the start of slot param_1 by mode: xor when the mode is -1, or when nonzero, and an and-not otherwise
0x102703C0.summary: Sets, clears or toggles mask flags in a slot by mode.

0x10270690.name: Mdl_ReleaseSlotPtr
0x10270690.evidence: when the pointer at +0xA4 of slot param_1 is nonnull, releases it with sqFree and clears it, then clears the dword at +0x8C
0x10270690.summary: Frees the slot's pointer at +0xA4 and clears its field at +0x8C.
